newsitem.title: USA: Chesapeake Energy prices common stock offer.
newsitem.headline: Chesapeake Energy prices common stock offer.

text.p: Chesapeake Energy Corp said on Wednesday it priced its four million common stock offering at $67.25 per share.

The offering would result in net proceeds to Chesapeake of about $256 million after underwriting discounts and expenses and excluding the potential $31 million in additional proceeds if the 486,000 share overallotment was exercised.
Chesapeake said it planned to use proceeds to increase its exploration and production activities, reduce debt and for general corporate purposes.
After the offering, Chesapeake would have about 34 million shares outstanding, it said.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corporation, Bear, Stearns & Co. Inc., J.P. Morgan & Co., and Prudential Securities Inc were the managing underwriters of the common stock offering.
